links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ARS patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Kincaid Grade Level and Reading Ease) of rhinology patient education materials
links.effect: Mean FKGL 8.6 for LLM-generated PEMs vs 10.28 for original ARS PEMs (P < .0001); Gemini best with mean FKGL 7.5 and FKRE 65.5
links.tradeoff: LLM outputs did not reach the sixth-grade target; authors advise cautious appraisal of LLM-generated content for accuracy.
links.quote: The original ARS PEMs had a mean FKGL of 10.28, while AI-generated PEMs demonstrated significantly better readability, with a mean FKGL of 8.6 (P < .0001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint (prompting LLMs to rewrite to sixth-grade level)
